name: Advanced Optimization for Business
description: The course aims to train advanced and cutting edge optimization techniques which can be applied to business needs. The course content includes: Robust Optimization, Stochastic Optimization, Dynamic Programming, Multi-Objective/Multi-level Optimization, Inverse Optimization and Online Optimization
